method: Read-only bounded review of collection-status backend, HTML and tests; no runtime database or process changes.

findings.description: Stored transport event age must be increased by time elapsed since heartbeat publication before judging its freshness.
findings.counterexample: An 80-second-old heartbeat reporting an 80-second-old event must not pass a 90-second freshness window.
